_about: Apps Script projects for GCX Mesh Schedules: descriptions + editable due-date constants (match = regex with the date as group 1). Editing rewrites the literal, clasp-pushes and commits; triggers built from a date need their setup function re-run in the editor.

projects.name: MasterTrigger (Apify Master daily job)
projects.what: Daily: starts every Apify review scraper, polls, distributes new reviews to the product sheets, posts a status card to Chat.
projects.schedule: One trigger per working day at 04:00 KST (skips weekends + KR holidays) up to MASTER_END_DATE; pollApifyRuns every 1 min while runs are pending.

dueDates.label: Daily job end date (MASTER_END_DATE)
dueDates.note: After saving, run createTriggers in the Apps Script editor to rebuild the per-day triggers.

projects.name: Auto Acc. / SDA Apify (shared project)
projects.what: Starts the Auto Accessories Apify product task and writes results to the sheet (SDA folder is the same project).
projects.schedule: One trigger per weekday 04:00 KST until endDate — but its handler runApifyNowAndPollAfter2Hours doesn't exist, so these fail (all currently disabled).

projects.name: Power Acc. Apify
projects.what: Starts the Power Accessories Apify product run, polls and writes the review sheet.

projects.name: iPhone 17e Apify
projects.what: iPhone 17e review sheet Apify run + poll (retired from MasterTrigger 2026-07-28).

projects.name: 전략폰 Apify
projects.what: 전략폰 review sheet Apify run + poll; writes a dated sheet.

projects.name: Bi-Weekly report builder
projects.what: Deck-bound script that builds the Bi-weekly claim/review cards and Overview charts.

projects.name: Ticket Daily Report (오전보고)
projects.what: Weekday 9AM: fetches Zendesk views, appends All_Graph and posts the morning report images to Chat; hosts the /report Chat app.
projects.schedule: Rolling: autoExtendZendeskTriggers daily ~06:00 keeps one-off Mon–Fri 09:00 triggers 30 days ahead; catch-up retries 5 min after failures (max 3/day).

dueDates.label: Legacy one-off triggers end (superseded by the rolling schedule)

projects.name: TCT Chat Log GCX
projects.what: Lazada/Shopee TCT log: Esc T2 alerts on edit, weekday close report (Thu 15:30, other days 17:30), Monday sync every 30 min (weekdays 08:00–17:30).
projects.schedule: Rolling: autoExtendEscT2Triggers daily ~06:00 keeps 30 days of one-off report triggers; syncListingIssuesToMonday every 30 min.

dueDates.label: Legacy one-off triggers end (superseded by the rolling schedule)

projects.name: ASIN Master (먼데이보드)
projects.what: Pulls Monday board 7606389164 into ASIN_Master; deletes ABM_Relay_Log rows older than 15 days.

projects.name: MCF automation
projects.what: MCF 발송 로그: SP-API tracking/fee lookups, onEdit automation, daily missing-tracking Chat report.
projects.schedule: backfillMCFFeesRecent every 30 min, retryR429Errors hourly, MCFReporter weekdays 9AM (installed by hand).

projects.name: Galaxy Z8 Monday → Sheet
projects.what: Full refresh of the Z8 sheet from Monday board 18421346787.

projects.name: Pixel 11 Monday → Sheet
projects.what: Full refresh of the Pixel 11 sheet from Monday board 18425190666.

projects.name: ABM Ticket Merge
projects.what: Zendesk webhook that merges duplicate Amazon Buyer Message tickets; reconciles relays.

projects.name: GCX Reply backend
projects.what: Web app backend for the GCX Reply Tampermonkey tool (SP-API lookups, ABM relay log).
projects.schedule: keepWarm every 5 min, refreshProductIndex every 15 min.

projects.name: PurchaseDate_Sync (Zendesk→monday)
projects.what: Copies Zendesk 'Purchase Date' into the Z8 / Pixel 11 / iPhone 18 Monday boards.

projects.name: SKU Sales Rating (Amazon.de)
projects.what: Weekly Apify run writing Amazon.de ratings per ASIN; syncs new ASINs into the task.

projects.name: 주요 디바이스별 아마존 세일즈 현황 (ratings)
projects.what: Weekday Apify run writing Amazon.de ratings into 4 device sheets; syncs new ASINs.

projects.name: 유지훈P Apify
projects.what: Daily Apify review + product scrapes; Chat alert on US sheet col K edits.
projects.schedule: dailyScrapeJob daily ~04:00 KST; onEditAlertToGoogleChat on edit.
